name: Uneed
measures: Monthly products submitted, launched and declined
about: Uneed publishes monthly aggregate statistics through its official launch-stats API. Launches use real launch dates and count products that are still published. Months follow America/Los_Angeles.
attribution: Source: Uneed, uneed.best. Monthly counts from https://mcp.uneed.best/v1/stats/launches; displayed as complete-month trends and year-over-year changes.
limitations: One site’s growth can reflect its own popularity rather than more software being built. AI’s impact cannot be isolated from these counts.
Launches exclude products no longer published; relaunches move products to later months, so history can change.
Submissions, launches and moderation decisions in a month concern different products. Their ratios are not acceptance or rejection rates. Repeat declines count again.
Submission and decline counts start in August 2026. Before the ledger started on 5 November 2026, submissions are estimated and may run high; August and September declines are lower bounds.
